info.title: Altri API
info.description:
Weekly leadership-meeting API (Measure → Commit → Resolve).

**Auth.** Sign in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login`; the session travels as an HttpOnly cookie or a Bearer token.
Every role and team rule is enforced here: a team the caller can't read is a 403 (even for unknown ids), and
Observers get a 403 on every write.

**Time.** Timestamps are UTC. Weeks are named by their Monday and run Monday-Sunday in the company time zone;
due dates are company-time calendar dates. "Now" comes from `APP_NOW`.

**Live updates.** `WS /api/v1/teams/{team_id}/live` pushes meeting state and "refetch" signals; see `live/router.py`.

**Errors.** `{"detail": ...}`. 401 no session, 403 no access / wrong role, 404 unknown item inside a readable
team, 409 the item's current state forbids the action (or a stale `expected_version`), 422 invalid input.

MeetingStateOut.title: MeetingStateOut
MeetingStateOut.description:
Everything a client needs to render the meeting. Pushed over the live socket on every change.

The server owns the timer: clients display `section_elapsed_seconds` advanced by their local clock from the
moment they received `server_now`, so all browsers agree regardless of their own clock skew.

past_due.title: Past Due
past_due.description: Not done and due before today. Due today is not past due

status.description: Computed: seeded status, or off_track if a Milestone is past due

open_issue_id.title: Open Issue Id
open_issue_id.description: Unsolved Issue raised from this Rock, if any

expected_version.title: Expected Version
expected_version.description: Optional lost-update guard: the `version` you edited (0 = there was no score). Omit for last-save-wins

weeks.title: Weeks
weeks.description: Week starts (Mondays, company time), oldest first, ending with the current week

section.description: Section to move to. Moving to the current section is a no-op
